fitReason: Method-focused robot-control backup: energy-guided generative policies are evaluated on simulated locomotion and AntMaze tasks. The broader programme is RL theory, language models and scientific AI, so direct robotics-project alignment must be confirmed.

physicalEvidence.summary: Full ICLR2025 QIPO paper develops Q-weighted flow/diffusion policy optimization and evaluates D4RL HalfCheetah, Hopper, Walker2d and AntMaze tasks. These are offline datasets and simulated environments, not real robots. No learned physical execution was verified; self-driving-laboratory interests on the research page are not evidence of an executed autonomous laboratory.
